chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
Do not rent land with wheat and then plant it with wheat.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to lease land for wheat and then cultivate it with wheat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal prohibition regarding leasing agricultural land in exchange for wheat when the land is then used to grow wheat. It relates to fiqh discussions on agricultural leasing, compensation, and avoiding impermissible or problematic contractual arrangements.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3908 - Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) that Imam (as) said:
"Do not rent land with wheat and then plant it with wheat."
